summary.headline: Messina Codex 27 Contents
summary.text: Description of Messina Codex 27 (F.A. 9), a fifteenth-century paper manuscript of 116 folios, including Porphyry’s introduction to Ptolemy’s Apotelesmatics, zodiacal configuration diagrams, an anonymous commentary on Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, astronomical tables, and fragments of Barlaam’s Logistica or Arithmetica. Cross-references cite Florentine, Bolognese, and Laurentian codices and works by Aquinas and Bandini.
